Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: chefboyrdave2.1
Message:
feat: add email screener and secret leak prevention modules

Email Screener (email_screener.py):
- Prompt injection detection (8 patterns including delimiter injection)
- Credential leak detection (AWS, GitHub, npm, Slack, OpenAI, JWT, etc.)
- Malicious link analysis (suspicious TLDs, IP-based URLs, phishing keywords)
- Phishing language detection (urgency patterns, account threats, spoofed senders)
- Social engineering detection (role manipulation, false authority, data exfil)
- Dangerous attachment screening (executables, double extensions)
- Batch screening support for processing multiple inputs

Secret Guard (secret_guard.py):
- 13 secret patterns (AWS, GitHub, npm, Stripe, SendGrid, Square, MongoDB, etc.)
- File and directory scanning with smart filtering (skips binaries, node_modules)
- Git staged file scanning for pre-commit integration
- Pre-commit hook generator that auto-blocks commits containing secrets
- Allow list support for known-safe patterns
- Test/example context detection to reduce false positives
- Remediation guidance for every secret type

Also:
- Fixed intelligence.py interface (added get_patterns, get_status methods)
- Fixed requirements.txt (removed stdlib modules that can't be pip-installed)
- Wired new modules into __init__.py and cli.py
- Bumped version to 1.1.0
- 59 tests, all passing

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
